paragraphs: R' Yitzhak of Kfar Akko. [He reported:] “R' Yohanan said,” as in Avodah Zarah 7b and Bekhorot 31a.[^1]

notes.text: The bracketed reporting frame makes Hyman’s terse א״ר יוחנן formula explicit: Yitzhak transmits Yohanan. כ is rendered “as in.” ז: and לא. give 7b and 31a under the colon/period convention; no named edition is independently checked. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
